verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The new ListTable records nodes that assert rdf:rest without rdf:first, fold_rights treats those nodes as collection-shaped, and well_formed_list consequently rejects them rather than folding them as ordinary scalar values. The added prohibition regression test exercises the real parse_policy_str path with a sibling permission and verifies refusal, while the permission-side and well-formed-list tests guard both parity and over-refusal. The shared table also preserves the existing logical-combinator handling. No new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident in the diff.
